description: Open-source AI penetration testing agent that exploit-verifies every finding. Autonomous 22-phase pentests of web apps & APIs with CVSS-scored PDF reports. Self-hosted, bring your own LLM, or run fully local with Ollama.

written.description: Runs a second, independent agent whose only job is to re-exploit what the first one claimed, so a finding is either reproduced or dropped. One self-hosted binary with a local dashboard.

alive.last_commit_message:
fix(agent): merge the notes inventory in build_plan instead of replacing the surface (#926)

build_plan set DiscoveredEndpoints to the paths parsed from the Endpoint
Inventory notes, dropping endpoints promoted from observed traffic, forms
and JS/API extraction, and wiping the surface to nil when no inventory note
existed. The planner hook already merges via mergeDiscoveredEndpoints;
build_plan now does the same.

Effects of the old behavior, each covered by a new test that fails on main:
- per-class tasks were measured against a smaller coverage denominator
- with no inventory note the denominator was empty, so one exercised
  endpoint closed a whole class via the VulnClassesTested fallback
- the planner refresh after build_plan derived applicability lanes
  (file-upload, GraphQL, ...) from the shrunken surface
